Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __not__ embedded in the test tube.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in a __different portion of__ the test tube.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is __exposed on the exterior surface of the test tube__ and oriented for reading downwards.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __not explicitly described in Maxell__.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded __in an alternative location within the test tube__.

Claim 22 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded __at a specified location__ in the test tube.

Claim 23 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is __integrated into the side of the test tube and oriented__ for reading downwards.
